  insert into public.class_materials (class_id, path, sort) select a.class_id, l->>'url', (l->>'csort')::int from jsonb_array_elements(d->'lessons') l join public.class_materials a on a.path = d->>'anchor' on conflict do nothing;
  insert into public.quizzes (id, topic_id, title, instructions, time_limit_minutes, max_attempts, published, show_results, category, feedback_mode, created_by)
    select (q->>'id')::uuid, t, q->>'title', q->>'instr', null, 2, true, true, 'quiz', 'hybrid', 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e' from jsonb_array_elements(d->'quizzes') q
    on conflict (id) do update set title = excluded.title, instructions = excluded.instructions, topic_id = excluded.topic_id;
  if exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'quizzes' and column_name = 'subject') then
    update public.quizzes set subject = 'Biology' where id in (select (q->>'id')::uuid from jsonb_array_elements(d->'quizzes') q);
  end if;
  insert into public.questions (id, topic_id, kind, prompt, options, marks, section, created_by) select (q->>'id')::uuid, t, q->>'kind', q->>'prompt', q->'options', (q->>'marks')::int, q->>'section', 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e' from jsonb_array_elements(d->'questions') q
    on conflict (id) do update set prompt = excluded.prompt, options = excluded.options, marks = excluded.marks, kind = excluded.kind, section = excluded.section;
  insert into public.question_answers (question_id, correct_option, model_answer, mark_scheme, points, explanation)
    select (q->>'id')::uuid, (q->>'correct')::int, case when q->>'kind' = 'mcq' then q->'options'->>((q->>'correct')::int) else q->>'model' end, case when q->>'kind' = 'mcq' then null else q->>'model' end,
           case when q->>'kind' = 'mcq' then null else q->'points' end, q->>'model' from jsonb_array_elements(d->'questions') q
    on conflict (question_id) do update set correct_option = excluded.correct_option, model_answer = excluded.model_answer, mark_scheme = excluded.mark_scheme, points = excluded.points, explanation = excluded.explanation;
  insert into public.quiz_questions (quiz_id, question_id, position) select (q->>'quiz')::uuid, (q->>'id')::uuid, (q->>'pos')::int from jsonb_array_elements(d->'questions') q
    on conflict (quiz_id, question_id) do update set position = excluded.position;
  insert into public.quiz_classes (quiz_id, class_id, published, published_at, published_by)
    select (q->>'id')::uuid, c.id, c.teacher_id = 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e', case when c.teacher_id = 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e' then now() end, case when c.teacher_id = 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e' then 'a9774d11-5d83-4bae-8da1-a6fb81c7dd7e'::uuid end
      from jsonb_array_elements(d->'quizzes') q cross join public.classes c where c.id in (select a.class_id from public.class_materials a where a.path = d->>'anchor')
    on conflict do nothing;
end $do$;
